text: Accustom your child to giving salam upon entering and leaving; practical qudwa (example) from you is more powerful than a thousand pieces of advice.

review_defects.arabic: القدوة العملية منك أبلغ من ألف توجيه
review_defects.english: practical qudwa (example) from you is more powerful than a thousand pieces of advice
review_defects.why: أبلغ means more eloquent/effective, not just 'powerful'; توجيه means guidance/direction, not 'advice'; the definite article 'the' is missing before 'practical qudwa'.
